phase_name: Deletion-reference audit, out-of-scope inventory, and final gate

objectives.description: Triage the ~76-file reference inventory into 3 buckets
Recommend follow-up as single scoped task (do not create it)
Confirm zero new task-number references outside specs/**

notes: audit-deletion-references.sh (research.md plan.md implement.md): Pass 1 (literal-name grep) = 0 hits, confirming zero dangling literal references to the deleted files anywhere under agent-system/extensions. Pass 2 (wildcard stem grep) = 146 hits, all inspected and confirmed to be the unrelated artifact-naming convention ({NN}_*-research.md / {NN}_*-plan.md report/plan filenames), not references to the deleted commands. Pass 3 (reachability) = same 3 pre-existing check-extension-docs.sh FAILs as baseline, plus generate-context-line-counts.sh --check PASSED cleanly (495/495 exact). Reference-surface inventory re-measured post-deletion: 73 files (baseline 76 minus commands/research.md and commands/plan.md, which no longer exist as files, minus merge-sources/claudemd.md, which Phase 2 already cleaned to zero command-name hits). Triaged all 73 into three buckets (counted by distinct file, several files carry hits in multiple buckets): OPERATIONAL (12 files -- instructs invocation of a now-dead command as a next step): commands/task.md, commands/project-overview.md, commands/merge.md, docs/guides/user-guide.md (troubleshooting steps), docs/examples/fix-it-flow-example.md, agents/meta-builder-agent.md (5 sites), skills/skill-fix-it/SKILL.md, context/meta/meta-guide.md (2 sites), skills/skill-project-overview/SKILL.md (5 sites), skills/skill-meta/SKILL.md, docs/architecture/orchestrate-state-machine.md, and skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md line 2708 -- HIGHEST PRIORITY: this is a live, non-deprecated skill file whose blocker-escalation message still suggests '(1) /research $task_number, (2) /revise $task_number, (3) /implement $task_number' as manual-intervention steps, two of which no longer exist as commands. DESCRIPTIVE (remaining ~58 files -- prose describing the historical three-command lifecycle without instructing invocation): README.md, commands/revise.md, commands/meta.md, scripts/orchestrate-recover-outcome.sh, commands/orchestrate.md, most of docs/guides/*, most of context/patterns/*, context/standards/*, context/orchestration/*, context/workflows/*, context/formats/*, and the skill/agent files' own prose descriptions of command routing. LEGITIMATE: context/standards/task-reference-exemptions.md:55 (a self-referential doc example of a concrete-number citation convention, not an instruction to invoke a command). WHOLESALE-ORPHANED files (content entirely or predominantly about the deleted commands; all 5 named at plan time, all confirmed still present): docs/examples/research-flow-example.md, context/processes/research-workflow.md, context/processes/planning-workflow.md, context/processes/implementation-workflow.md, context/patterns/multi-task-operations.md. Confirmed via index-entries.json inspection that all three context/processes/*-workflow.md files already carry on_demand:true with an empty load_when.commands array -- a PRE-EXISTING condition unrelated to this task's changes (not newly broken reachability), consistent with the 93-entry pattern found in Phase 3. Final gate set: check-extension-docs.sh byte-identical to Phase 1 baseline (3 pre-existing unrelated FAILs, zero new); check-task-references.sh (deployed) PASS, 0 unexempted occurrences across 4 trees; test-conflict-predicate.sh 33/33 passed; test-four-tier-conflict.sh 13/13 passed; jq . parses both manifest.json and index-entries.json cleanly; none of the six Phase-3-retargeted load_when.commands arrays is empty; zero grep hits for the three deleted command paths under scripts/; merge-sources/claudemd.md carries zero command-name uses of /research or /implement (only legitimate noun/orchestrate uses remain). Manual smoke: /orchestrate resolves in both source and deployed trees; its Options table documents all three phase-forcing flags with full semantics.
